title: Noodling Nautilus
statement: Drifting through a twilight-indigo tank of swaying sea-ferns, sunken ceramic teacups, and softly glowing sea-glass, this daydreaming cephalopod spends its hours sorting smooth pebbles by color and spiral symmetry. Whenever a visitor pauses by the glass, it puffs a quiet ring of bubbles and nudges a bright shell forward as if inviting them to solve a puzzle together.
